conventions.name: 5TC basket, 180,000 t (to 24 December 2025)
conventions.rule: C5TC = Sum(C8_14 x 0.25, C9_14 x 0.125, C10_14 x 0.25, C14 x 0.25, C16 x 0.125), the Baltic Capesize (BCI180) of 180,000 dwt, every route at 5 percent total commission
conventions.source: Baltic Exchange, Guide to Market Benchmarks v7.09 (December 2025)

conventions.name: 5TC basket, 182,000 t (from 2 January 2026)
conventions.source: Baltic Exchange, Guide to Market Benchmarks v8.8 (September 2026)

conventions.name: Capesize futures, EEX
conventions.rule: CPTM (180,000 t basket) and C5TM (182,000 t basket): one day a lot, USD a day to two decimals, the underlying the arithmetic average of all the Baltic's daily assessments of the month; December's last registration day is 24 December. (BDRY's filings name its 180 kt contract C5TCM, a data vendor ticker.)
conventions.source: EEX Contract Specifications for Trade Registration, release 047a (23 July 2026)

conventions.name: TD3C route
conventions.rule: 270,000 t Middle East Gulf to China (Ras Tanura to Ningbo), laydays 15/30 days from index date, age max 15 years, 3.75 percent total commission; published in Worldscale (TD3C), in USD a tonne (TD3C$) and as a round-trip TCE (TD3C-TCE: 2 days load, 2 discharge, 2 waiting)
conventions.source: Baltic Exchange, Guide to Market Benchmarks v8.8 (September 2026)

conventions.name: TD3C futures, ICE (TDL)
conventions.rule: 1,000 t a lot, USD a tonne to 0.0001; final settlement the average of the Baltic's assessments for each Baltic publication day of the month; December expires on the 24th or the business day before
conventions.source: ICE Futures Europe, TD3C FFA Middle East Gulf to China (Baltic) Future (TDL), contract specification

conventions.name: Gross against net
conventions.rule: A time charter index and its FFA are gross daily hire; a voyage TCE is net of commission and is grossed up by it before the comparison; the owner keeps the net share, so its hedge is the voyage's days times that share
conventions.source: Baltic Exchange, Guide to Market Benchmarks v8.8 (September 2026)

conventions.name: Baltic standard Capesize of the date
conventions.rule: BCI182 from 2 January 2026: 14 knots on 52 t laden, 44 t ballast (GMB v8.8 page 78). BCI180 before: 14 knots laden or 15 knots ballast on 62 t, 12 or 13 knots on 43 t (GMB v7.09 page 76). Each priced at its fastest pairs.
conventions.source: Baltic Exchange, Guide to Market Benchmarks v8.8 (September 2026); Baltic Exchange, Guide to Market Benchmarks v7.09 (December 2025)

conventions.name: Publication days
conventions.rule: London business days: weekdays less England and Wales bank holidays, by statute and proclamation
conventions.source: Banking and Financial Dealings Act 1971; Amplify Commodity Trust 10-Q (30 September 2025)

formulas.name: Settlement
formulas.text: S(month) = average of the Baltic's assessments on every publication day of the month; a quarter is the average of its three months

formulas.name: Basis
formulas.text: basis = FFA - spot, per tenor, on the same basket

formulas.name: Strip
formulas.text: F0 = sum over months of days(month) x F(month) / voyage days, days counted from the fixture date

formulas.name: Hedge size
formulas.text: FFA days in a month = voyage days in that month x (1 - commission) x k; TD3C in tonnes equal to the cargo

formulas.name: Paper
formulas.text: short (owner): (F0 - S) x size; long (charterer): (S - F0) x size

formulas.name: Surprise
formulas.text: U = gross TCE - F0; hedged = U - k (S - F0); effectiveness = 1 - Var(hedged) / Var(U)

formulas.name: Residual at k = 1
formulas.text: TCE - S = (TCE - 5TC on the day) route + (5TC on the day - S on the ship's basket) timing + (S ship - S curve) size

formulas.name: Forecast error
formulas.text: error = S - F(h months before expiry); roll cost of a rolling long = F - S (positive: the long pays, the short earns)

formulas.name: Worldscale
formulas.text: USD a tonne = WS / 100 x flat rate
